title: mcp-toolmon T7: real-subprocess transparent-reload + crash-mid-flight + full regression
detail: Covers: transparent_reload_end_to_end_subprocess (real mcp-toolmon subprocess through real on-disk watcher swap, R5/R6/R9), crash_mid_flight_every_id_answered (real OS-level child kill mid-flight, R6/R7), windows_lock_freedom (pre-existing, re-verified).
